title: Psychedelics reduce brain activity while enriching experience

statements.text: Neuroimaging shows that psychedelics largely decrease brain activity while intensifying experience, the opposite of what the view that the brain generates experience would expect.

sources.quote: Yet, recent neuroimaging studies have shown that psychedelics do largely the opposite (Carhart-Harris et al. 2012; Palhano-Fontes et al. 2015; Carhart-Harris et al. 2016).
